answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The garden holds work receipts rather than names, so the violet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the willow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
